Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxDepth: 0, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.contentType);
  console.log(result.html);
  console.log(result.metadata.title);
  console.log(result.metadata.description);
  console.log(result.metadata.canonicalUrl);
  console.log(result.links.length);
  console.log(result.links[0].linkType);
  console.log(result.images.length);
  console.log(result.metadata.ogTitle);
}

void main();
```
